barbarian_rage.name: Rage
barbarian_rage.description: Enter a battle fury for up to 10 rounds. You resist bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage and add rage damage to Strength-based melee weapon hits. Heavy armor prevents this feature.

barbarian_reckless_attack.name: Reckless Attack
barbarian_reckless_attack.description: Throw caution aside: gain advantage on your Strength-based melee attacks, while attacks against you have advantage until your next turn.

fighter_second_wind.name: Second Wind
fighter_second_wind.description: As a bonus action, regain 1d10 hit points plus your Fighter level. It cannot revive a downed character.

fighter_action_surge.name: Action Surge
fighter_action_surge.description: Push beyond your normal limits to regain your action for this turn.

monk_flurry_of_blows.name: Flurry of Blows
monk_flurry_of_blows.description: After taking the Attack action, spend 1 Focus Point and use your bonus action to make two Unarmed Strikes against a nearby foe.

monk_patient_defense.name: Patient Defense
monk_patient_defense.description: Spend 1 Focus Point and use your bonus action to defend yourself; attacks against you have disadvantage until your next turn.

rogue_cunning_dash.name: Cunning Action: Dash
rogue_cunning_dash.description: Use your bonus action to Dash, gaining movement equal to your walking speed this turn.

rogue_cunning_disengage.name: Cunning Action: Disengage
rogue_cunning_disengage.description: Use your bonus action to avoid opportunity attacks while moving this turn.

rogue_steady_aim.name: Steady Aim
rogue_steady_aim.description: If you have not moved this turn, use your bonus action to gain advantage on your next attack. Your movement becomes zero for the turn.

rogue_cunning_withdraw.name: Cunning Strike: Withdraw
rogue_cunning_withdraw.description: Queue Withdraw for your next eligible Sneak Attack. Spend one Sneak Attack die to avoid opportunity attacks for the rest of your turn.

rogue_cunning_trip.name: Cunning Strike: Trip
rogue_cunning_trip.description: Queue Trip for your next eligible Sneak Attack. Spend one Sneak Attack die; the target makes a Dexterity save or falls prone.

rogue_cunning_poison.name: Cunning Strike: Poison
rogue_cunning_poison.description: Queue Poison for your next eligible Sneak Attack. Spend one Sneak Attack die; the target makes a Constitution save or is poisoned.
